quest.title: Witch's Revelation: Instruction of Curious Form
quest.description: You encounter Qiqi at Barbeloth's fortune-telling booth...
quest.rewards_formatted: Mora x20000, Guide to Prosperity x3

dialogues.speaker: Blathine
dialogues.text: Is it coming back to you yet, Qiqi?

dialogues.speaker: Qiqi
dialogues.text: Oh... Uhm... I'm sorry...

dialogues.speaker: Blathine
dialogues.text: There's no need to apologize. We still have a long way before we get to the Palais Mermonia. Let's keep walking for now — I'm sure you'll remember where your home is soon.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Look, it's Qiqi! And she's with a Melusine. That's a combo Paimon wasn't expecting to see!

dialogues.speaker: Qiqi
dialogues.text: #Ah! {NICKNAME}, and... Pai... Paimon...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hello.

dialogues.speaker: Blathine
dialogues.text: You know Qiqi? Fantastic news! I ran into her while investigating near Lumidouce Harbor... Judging by her size, I figured she was a human child... She is a child, right?

dialogues.speaker: Qiqi
dialogues.text: I am... am...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Our good friend!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Right, right! We go way back. We're the best of friends!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe! Quick thinking! If Qiqi had said she was a zombie, it might've scared her half to death!

dialogues.speaker: Qiqi
dialogues.text: Yes... Best of... friends... That's right.

dialogues.speaker: Blathine
dialogues.text: Well, this is a happy coincidence for sure. To be honest, this is the first time I've ever found myself completely at a loss...

dialogues.speaker: Blathine
dialogues.text: I take it you know about her memory issues? She can hardly seem to remember anything besides her own name.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Qiqi gets like that sometimes.

dialogues.speaker: Blathine
dialogues.text: Poor child. I was going to take her back to the Marechaussee Phantom and let her stay there for a while, but I hoped she might get some of her memories back on the road.

dialogues.speaker: Blathine
dialogues.text: Since you're such good friends, I take it you know where she lives? It would save a lot of trouble if I could take her straight home.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We know... But it's, uhm, a very long way from here...

dialogues.speaker: Qiqi
dialogues.text: Very... long way...? Hmm... I followed a Seelie all the way to Lumidouce Harbor...

dialogues.speaker: Blathine
dialogues.text: Huh? You remembered something? What happened before that?

dialogues.speaker: Qiqi
dialogues.text: Before... that... Dr. Baizhu took me on his rounds at Yi... Uhm, Yi-something-something... I went to gather herbs, and then...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh! Baizhu took you to Yilong Wharf, right? Detective Paimon thinks she knows what happened!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Baizhu took Qiqi to visit patients at Yilong Wharf. She got lost while gathering herbs, saw a Seelie, and followed it all the way to Lumidouce Harbor!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Hehe, good thing Paimon and {NICKNAME} read Robben versus Chesterton! Simple deductions like these are a piece of cake for Paimon now.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You do know that book's a work of fiction, right?

dialogues.speaker: Blathine
dialogues.text: Aha! Well, that checks out! I'll take Qiqi back to Yilong Wharf right away. Dr. Baizhu is Qiqi's guardian, is he? He must be worried sick!

choices.text: Wait... Those people in Barbeloth's prophecy...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, you're right! Paimon almost forgot about that. Barbeloth — are you there? Can you hear us?

response.speaker: Barbeloth
response.text: No need to shout. I've been here all along. I simply didn't want to interrupt your conversation. Listening is the default state of any good fortune teller.

response.speaker: Barbeloth
response.text: This Seelie's so-called guidance could also be considered the guidance of fate. Hehe... Since you're here, Qiqi, why not let me read your fortune?

response.speaker: Qiqi
response.text: For... tune...?

response.speaker: Alice
response.text: Oh dear, Barbie, allow me to interject. You're really not suited to talking to children, you know — you're scaring the poor girl.

response.speaker: Alice
response.text: Let me take this one. Now listen closely — this is how you deliver a little surprise gift.

response.speaker: Alice
response.text: Ahem... Little Qiqi, member of the Little Hexenzirkel, I'm the mother of your ally Klee — Auntie Alice, the greatest witch in the world.

response.speaker: Qiqi
response.text: Nice to meet you, Auntie Alice...

response.speaker: Alice
response.text: Ah, what a sweet, polite little child. Come now, let Auntie's friend, another great witch, throw you a wonderful surprise fortune-telling party!

response.speaker: Qiqi
response.text: Fortune-telling... party?

response.speaker: Alice
response.text: That's right! Look at the cards in front of you. Aren't they pretty? Do you like them?

response.speaker: Qiqi
response.text: I... like them...

response.speaker: Alice
response.text: That's wonderful! Now, can you pick one for me?

response.speaker: Qiqi
response.text: Uhm... Is this one alright?

response.speaker: Alice
response.text: Of course. And because you were so wonderfully well-behaved, that card is yours to keep!

response.speaker: Qiqi
response.text: Uh... Thank you?

response.speaker: Alice
response.text: Alright, Barbie, break time's over. Come help little Qiqi with her reading.

response.speaker: Barbeloth
response.text: You don't need to shake me awake... I've been listening the whole time. Ah, upright Hanged Man.

response.speaker: Barbeloth
response.text: Very few people draw this card.

response.speaker: Alice
response.text: That means you're very special, Qiqi.

response.speaker: Barbeloth
response.text: It symbolizes transcendence and waiting, and also detachment from the everyday world.

response.speaker: Barbeloth
response.text: There are shackles that bind you, but you yourself have no desire to break free from them.

response.speaker: Qiqi
response.text: Shackles... Do you mean... my orders?

response.speaker: Barbeloth
response.text: At least on the surface, you wouldn't be wrong to understand things in such a way.

response.speaker: Barbeloth
response.text: As for your future, all you need to do is wait. Of course, it's not like you lack for time... But... Oh my, how strange, how very strange...

response.speaker: Alice
response.text: Hold up a second! You're saying too much at once. Give the poor child a moment to breathe.

response.speaker: Alice
response.text: Let Qiqi savor her little gift first. You really do need to show a little more patience with children...

response.speaker: Alice
response.text: What do you think, Qiqi? Do you like your surprise?

response.speaker: Qiqi
response.text: This card is pretty... Thank you, Auntie Alice.

response.speaker: Alice
response.text: Aww, good girl — you did such a good job remembering Auntie's name. Auntie would love to chat with you some more, but it's time for you to go home.

response.speaker: Alice
response.text: If Auntie Barbie has more to say, then next time the Hexenzirkel meets, she can make a prophecy for every little witch who attends! Wouldn't that be lovely?

response.speaker: Barbeloth
response.text: ...Could you not add to my workload without asking me first?

response.speaker: Alice
response.text: Then it's settled! See you next time, Qiqi, and all of you witnesses, hehe.

response.speaker: Qiqi
response.text: Bye-bye... Auntie Alice... and Auntie Alice's... best of friends.

response.speaker: Blathine
response.text: Phew... Is that all over now? Did those two voices just come from this doll? What kind of toy is this? It's so cute, where can I...

response.speaker: Blathine
response.text: Ugh! No, that's not important right now. Qiqi, let's go find that Dr. Baizhu of yours.

response.speaker: Qiqi
response.text: #...Mmhmm, it's time... Qiqi should go home. See you... next time, {NICKNAME}... and Paimon.

response.speaker: Qiqi
response.text: Card... Gift... Hmm... Pretty...

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: I think that's everyone I needed to see, but where's Qiqi? She can't still be gathering herbs, can she?

dialogues.speaker: Changsheng
dialogues.text: Perhaps you should prescribe yourself some medicine to stop you overthinking... There's still plenty of time left until her orders say to be back.
